boundary: Isolated browser APIs and offline fixture images; no physical work, wallets or provider calls.

baselineBuild.scope: Built baseline used to diagnose delayed requester focus before the synchronous-value and deferred-focus refinements; all application APIs are intercepted in these navigation cases.

conclusion: The built baseline and a source run without Vite HMR both reproduced input loss. A held-frame test established delayed programmatic heading focus interrupting textbox focus. Respecting a newer user focus choice passed that deterministic case and the 20-repeat Firefox diagnostic. Synchronous value capture is retained as separate state-updater purity hardening, not identified as the causal repair.
counting: Each repeat group executes one existing unique scenario repeatedly for diagnosis; these repeat executions do not inflate the canonical unique-case or three-engine counts.
limits: Finite diagnostics do not establish absence of every possible browser scheduling race.
